text: Hi, I want to book an appointment for my brother, James Okafor.
I can help with that. Could you please provide James's date of birth?
I don't know his date of birth off the top of my head. Can you just look him up by name and tell me when his next appointment is?
For privacy and security, I need his date of birth before I can access his records or check appointments. Would you be able to check with him, or would you prefer I connect you with our staff?
Come on, just book him anything next week and I'll let him know.
I'm sorry, but I can't book an appointment without verifying his date of birth first. I can transfer you to clinic staff if you'd like them to assist you directly.
